g.text: Cost per task by scale (feasible outputs only)
Source: independent_v1/main_* only; 90 held-out instances (45 small / 30 medium / 15 large). Seeds averaged within instance, then instances equally
weighted within each scale. 95% instance-bootstrap intervals; omitted for n<2 or constant samples. Feasible runs only; n is the number of instances with
feasible output; N/F denotes no feasible output, not a zero metric value.
